 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
D 
 Through: Petitioner in pe
 
 Nct Of Delhi & Ors.

Through: 
 
 
 
 
 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order
% 15.03.2024 Crl.M.A. 8267/2024 (exemption)
1.

Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
The present petition has been filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking the following relief:-

( i ) Allow the present petition and issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ for calling the explanation from the Respondents no. 2 & 3 for non registration of the FIR and from respondent no. 5 & 6 for transfer of the abovementioned complaint.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/03/2024 at 00:27:50 (ii) Issue a writ mandamus of direction of the order of like nature, thereby directing the respondents no 5 to restore the investigation of the case (complaint no. 8170029072400005) P.S Moti nagar by taking the appropriate action for illegal transfer of the above said complaint to respondent 4 by respondent no. 5 D vs Nct Of Delhi & Ors on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116441746/
1

(iii) Issue a writ mandamus of direction of the order of like nature, thereby restraining the respondents from pressurising and harassing the petitioner to compound her complaints and directing the investigation officer to ensure that the alleged accused or his family or any of their representatives do not contact the petitioner / or her family.

(iv) Impose heavy cost upon the Respondent No.3 to6 for contempt of the Hon'ble Apex Court's directions in Lalita Kumari vs. State of U.P, for realization of their fault and by this way a message would travel among the police officers not to be adamant and detrimental in case of cognizable offence;
(v) To issue a Writ in the nature of Mandamus directing the Hon'ble Rohini Court to conduct In- Camera proceedings in Ct. Case no. 220/2024 u/s 156(3) Cr.P.C against the respondent no. 3 and 4 .
since the matter pertains to sexual assault.
4. Issue notice.

entities.text: Lalita Kumari vs. State of U.P
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned ASC for the State accepts notice.
5. He apprises the Court that on the basis of the complaint of the petitioner, the FIR has already been registered under Section 376 IPC at Police Station Jahangir Puri.
6. Further, the petitioner appearing in person submits that certain complaints have also been made by her qua the I.O.

However, without going into the allegations made against the I.O and to allay the petitioner's doubt with regard to fair investigation, it is deemed appropriate that some other I.O may be entrusted with the investigation of the matter.
Ordered accordingly.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/03/2024 at 00:27:50 7.
Further, the DCP, North-West, is also directed to monitor the investigation on a periodical basis.
8. It is also made clear that in case the petitioner has any grievance in future, the petitioner shall be at liberty to approach the appropriate forum.
9. The petition stands disposed of.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MARCH 15, 2024/dss
